Lot passports

What it is

A lot passport is a public page for one lot, with a QR for the bag. It shows the chain from plot to harvest, run, green lot and roast. Each entry is signed by the phone that made it and linked to the one before, and each day's entries are stamped into the Bitcoin public record through OpenTimestamps. Anyone who scans the QR sees every check run in their own browser.

Also inOne coffee, one chainRecords you can trust

What it is

The passport page says plainly what it proves: the entries were made by the phones shown, in this order, and have not been changed since the day they were stamped. What it cannot prove is that what was typed in was true. Honest records, photos and buyers who come back do that part.

Also inRecords you can trustGuidance, not guarantee

Step 1 · Choose the name on my passports

Open Passports from the menu. Under Name shown on your passports, type your farm, estate or roastery name and tap Save. Your email is never shown.

Try it in the app ›

Also inGetting set upRecords you can trust

Step 2 · Make a passport for a lot

Open the green lot in Origin and tap Passport and QR at the top (you need to be signed in). The app lists every record it is about to seal, from the estate down to this lot.

Try it in the app ›

Also inOne coffee, one chain

Step 3 · Decide what the public sees

Under What the public sees, the farm location and plot outline, and notes written on records, are off unless you tick them. A buyer in Europe may need the outline; tick it only when they do.

Try it in the app ›

Also inRecords you can trust

Step 4 · Seal it

Tap Sign and seal. Each record is signed on this phone and linked to the one before. You will see the lot's page: its public link with Copy link, Print labels and Open passport, and a line saying whether all entries check out and the weights add up.

Also inOne coffee, one chainRecords you can trust

Watch out

The public stamp is not instant. The public page says it is waiting for the daily stamp: each day's entries are stamped the next morning, about 6 am India time.

Also inRecords you can trustNothing gets lost

Step 5 · Seal new records later

After a new roast, or a change to a record already sealed, open the lot and tap Seal changes. The open record's button reads Passport: seal changes while something is waiting.

Try it in the app ›

Also inRecords you can trust

Step 6 · Prove a photo is the original

Under Photos, Add photo fingerprints. The photo stays on this phone; only its fingerprint and your note go into the passport. Later anyone can check, on the public page, that a photo you send them is the original and unchanged.

Try it in the app ›

Also inRecords you can trust

Step 7 · Split a lot into retail packs

Under Packs, Split into packs: how many, grams each, and whether they come from roasts or stock held. Each pack gets its own QR, and pack weights are checked against what was roasted or held.

Handing a lot to a buyer

Step 8 · Send a lot to a buyer

Under Hand over, type the Buyer email, a name to show if you like, and the Weight sent, kg, then tap Sign and send. The buyer confirms on their own phone the weight they received, and can add their own roasts to the same passport. Their email is only used to reach them, never shown.

Also inOne coffee, one chainKilos carry forward

What it is

The passport adds up the weights along the chain. Weights add up means nobody sent or roasted more than they held.

Also inKilos carry forwardRecords you can trust

Step 9 · Receive a lot someone sent me

When a farm hands over a lot, you get an email. Sign in and open Passports. Under Lots sent to you, the lot waits with the weight the farm says it sent. Weigh the coffee, type the Weight you received, kg and tap Confirm receipt. This is signed with your phone and adds the lot to your green coffee in Origin. See passport opens the lot's page first.

Try it in the app ›

Also inOne coffee, one chainKilos carry forward

What it is

Anyone who scans the QR sees the lot's passport page. At the top it says whether all entries check out, whether the daily public stamp has come, and whether the weights add up. Below, each record is shown in order from the estate to the lot, with who signed it. A handoff shows as Received 30 kg. The farm's location and notes appear only if the farm chose to show them.

Try it in the app ›

Step 10 · Check a photo someone sent me

On the passport page, under Photos, choose the file under Check a photo. It matches only if it is the original file, unchanged. The photos stay with their owner; the passport holds only each one's fingerprint.

Try it in the app ›

Also inRecords you can trust

Step 11 · Take a passport off the public page

Under Withdraw, Withdraw passport removes the details from the public page. Fingerprints already stamped stay in the public record; that is what makes the passport trustworthy.

Try it in the app ›

Selling into Europe

What it is

The EU deforestation rule (EUDR) covers coffee sold into Europe. Each lot must come from land where no forest was cleared after 31 December 2020, must be grown under the country's laws, and must be traceable to the plots it grew on. The company that brings it into Europe files the due diligence statement; your part is to hand over complete, true records. The app's EUDR guide explains this in plain words.

Try it in the app ›

Also inGuidance, not guaranteeOne coffee, one chain

Step 12 · See what a lot still needs for Europe

Open the green lot and tap EUDR. The app names any plot data still missing (a location, an outline). It also holds the Product form, the HS code it suggests from the form (the customs code for the goods), and the importer's statement reference once they file it.

Also inOne coffee, one chainGuidance, not guarantee

Step 13 · Gather everything a buyer asks for

Tap For a buyer on the lot. One sheet gathers the lot passport, the EUDR lot file, the EU plot file and sack labels.

Try it in the app ›

Also inOne coffee, one chain

Step 14 · Make the EUDR lot file

From For a buyer, open the EUDR lot file. On one page, made from your records, it shows the lot, the product, quantity, when and where it was produced, the plots, the producer and the land check. Missing items show in red. Print or save as PDF to send it.

Also inOne coffee, one chainGuidance, not guarantee

Watch out

The EU plot file holds the exact plot outline. Share it only with the buyer who needs it. Wages and workers' names never go into these files.

Also inRecords you can trustOne coffee, one chain

What it is

The Legality pack puts the producer, land papers, licences, taxes and the team on one page for a buyer. The team shows as a count, never names or wages. It is gathered from Origin, Land and dues, and Team and wages, with gaps shown. It lists what is recorded; it is not a certificate.
